providers.name: Groq
providers.access: proxy only (the key stays on the site server)
providers.quotaReset: daily: per-model request and token limits (about 1,000 requests a day)

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.access: browser or proxy (visitors can use their own key in the browser)
providers.keyOwner: site owner on the server; the visitor in the browser
providers.quotaReset: daily: 50 free requests a day under $10 lifetime credit, 1,000 after; 20 a minute
providers.trainsOnData: depends on the model: some free endpoints log or train on prompts

providers.name: Pollinations
providers.access: browser (called directly from the visitor's browser, no server)
providers.keyOwner: none (anonymous tier); visitors may add their own key
